create_QALabelling_model: create a QALabelling Pydantic model instance to classify a QA pair with scope, alignment, and correctness labels
build_QA_scope_label: build a QAScopeLabel literal type to classify questions as corpus, document, or out of scope
build_QA_alignment_label: build a QAAlignmentLabel literal type to classify question-context alignment as aligned, tangential, or misaligned
build_QA_information_label: build a QAInformationLabel literal type to classify QA information as fact, summary, reasoning, or procedure
test_QALabelling_validation: test QALabelling model validation to ensure only valid scope, alignment, correctness, completeness, and information labels are accepted
